formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x1 x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => x1 = x2 ∨ x1 = x2 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)); have x2 : (Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x2 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x1 x3 x4 ∧ x2 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3) = Bool.true ∧ x2 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true; ∃ (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ),   x3.size ≤ (64 : ℕ) ∧     PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (26 : ℕ) x3 ∧       (∀ x7 ∈ x3.gates, x7.inputs.Nodup) ∧         x3.output = (26 : ℕ) + x4 ∧           x3.gates[x4]? = Option.some { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x5, x6] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } ∧             (∀ (x7 x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)),                 x1 x7 x8 →                   have x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x10 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x7 ∨ x10 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x8);                   PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x3 (26 : ℕ) x10 x5 = Bool.true ∧ PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x3 (26 : ℕ) x10 x6 = Bool.true) ∧               ∀ (x7 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), Maximal (fun (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) => ¬x2 x8) x7 → PEqualNP.BlindGate.wireValue x3 (26 : ℕ) x7 (if x7 (13 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) = Bool.true then x5 else x6) = Bool.false)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3 as in the parent: some AND/OR circuit of at most 64 gates, each reading two distinct earlier wires, has as output an AND of wires a and b, both true at every incident one-point-one-line input, such that at every maximal input where incidence is false, a is false if line input y0 is on, and b is false otherwise.
